metadata.title: Remove Provision Status from Duplicate OPV Entries

blocks.content: The incident requests deletion of P status values for a small set of OPV rows in fm_opv after validation against the attachment.

items: Verify the Excel attachment for the final list of home IDs.
Run a SELECT against fm_opv to confirm the current status values.
Update the status field to an empty string for the matching provision rows.
Insert audit entries in support_tasks_log after the update.

blocks.content:
SELECT "homeId", "accessNumber", "status" FROM fm_opv WHERE "homeId" IN ('AHE004454399002', 'AHE004454399003', 'AHE004454399004') AND "accessNumber" IN (450812345, 450812346, 450812347);

UPDATE fm_opv SET "status" = '' WHERE "homeId" IN ('AHE004454399002', 'AHE004454399003', 'AHE004454399004') AND "accessNumber" IN (450812345, 450812346, 450812347) AND "status" = 'P';

blocks.label: Validation Checklist
items: Status changed from P to blank
